attBesluta.text: Good buy for the grandkids to be able to play outside and get a little dirt on their hands. Should have gone with the bigger size, but they still like this one just fine.
Grandkids love it. Very spacious only thing i would say is cover isn't that great and could do with being thicker but overall the kids love it so that's what's important.

Ok pour 2/3enfants, montage facile, il se fixe au sol avec des piquets, 300kilos de sable nécessaire voir un peu plus. Payé 89e, je trouve le prix cher pour ce que c est au final (quelques montants en plastique, une bache de fond, une bache de protection avec lanières qui tient malgre le vent, et quelques tiges de fixation...). Néanmoins les enfants l adorent. Livraison parfaite.
Good is a bit shorter than id like it. My 2 years old fit, but im afraid he'll outgrow it by age 5.
Prefect for my grandkids. Easy to assemble great quality
Der Aufbau ist gut beschrieben und alleine problemlos machbar. Die Qualität des Materials ist sehr gut.

The bottom liner is made of thick Oxford fabric, it’s really wear-resistant and can handle all kinds of outdoor conditions. No tearing, no leaking, even after heavy rain and lots of use. It’s held up perfectly.

This sandbox is made of thick HDPE material, it’s really sturdy and can handle all kinds of outdoor weather. Sun, rain, wind, it still looks brand new after months of use. No fading or cracking at all.

The sandbox was very easy to assemble. Quality is ok for the price. I have to say I would pay extra for sturdier wood. It holds well under the rain. We've been using it daily for almost a month. So far so good.
Great sandbox - used our own screws after reading other reviews
Très bon produit de qualité pour nôtre petit fils Je conseille fortement Site de confiance N'hésitez pas

Was delivered on time as promised, was easy to assemble and a bonus was there was 1 extra screw ‹NAMN› each section of assembly. I guess just in case you lost one in the grass on assembly, nice. Set your power driver so that the screws auto stop at flush as the cedar is soft. The size was what we wanted and the folding cover will keep the pine needles and leaves out of the sand box. And cats will not be able to use it as their litter box. I dug the hole 9 inches of depth ‹NAMN› more sand and the sand supplier gave more than we needed ‹NAMN› free (has own children). The bottom liner was ample to line the hole but I added an extra layer from on hand weed mat. You do not have to dig a hole but I did. have been happy with all the Vevor products I have purchased.
Great sandbox.easy to assemble. The lid makes it great to keep it clean from the night animals. My kids love it.

My grandson loves his new sandbox! It’s sturdy and looks great in the front yard. The bench seats keep him comfortable while he is playing without getting too much sand his pockets! Overall we are very pleased with this product.
A great size and great quality! The cover is perfect and very waterproof too. Our kids absolutely love this sandbox!
Je l'aime beaucoup, bonne qualité, belle grandeur et j'aime b9la toile pour le fermer.

I really like this sandbox! It’s very spacious, giving the kids plenty of room to play and dig. The cover is also super durable and easy to take on and off, which makes cleanup and protection from the weather really convenient. Definitely a great addition to our backyard!

Acheté pour mon petit-fils lorsqu'il vient chez moi, et qu'il avait choisi parmi les différents modèles de la marque. Simple à monter/assembler même pour une femme seule. Juste quelques pré perçages non faits, ou pas totalement. Le bois ne semble pas être de mauvaise qualité, ni de très bonne, donc à voir dans le temps comment il vieillira car il est traité mais pour durer combientième d'années? La bâche bleue est bien pratique contre les intempéries (déjà subi des trombes d'eau et la canicule) et les chats (j'en ai 2). Comptez entre 250 kg (minimum) et 300 kg de sable pour le remplir suffisamment.
